verified_facts.picking_methods: Core strategies: discrete/order, batch, cluster, zone, wave (waveless/order-streaming as modern variant); WMS guides pick assignments and pick paths; hybrids common (batched clusters for e-com + timed waves for wholesale). Source: leafio.ai, conveyco.com, storefeeder.com.
verified_facts.returns_volume: Returns are ~20-30% of total e-commerce order volume; fashion up to 40%+. Avg cost per return ~USD 20 (range USD 22-50). Source: sgsystemsglobal.com, DHL (dhl.com/discover id-id). RMA flow: authorization -> receipt into WMS -> inspection/grading -> disposition (restock/repair/refurbish/recycle/dispose) -> inventory update.
verified_facts.b3_regulation: Indonesia: PP No. 22/2021 (Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan dan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup) governs B3 & limbah B3; Permen LHK No. 6/2021 details TPS Limbah B3 (temporary storage) requirements — labeling/symbol, segregation, storage conditions. GHS hazard classification + K3/HSE apply. Source: KLHK regulations, crpg.info, academic K3 journals.
verified_facts.sap_ewm: SAP EWM supports: putaway strategies (bin determination by process type, stock type, quantity classification, PRODUCT HAZARD RATING), Process-Oriented Storage Control (POSC) for multi-step put/pick, wave management, picking, packing via packaging specifications (cartonization), value added services (VAS), work centers (deconsolidation, QI, packing, VAS), staging, loading. Inbound: unload/count/deconsolidation/QI/VAS/putaway. Outbound: pick/pack/VAS/staging/load. Source: learning.sap.com, sap-press.com, 4flow.com.
verified_facts.peak_season: Harbolnas 2024: Rp31,2 triliun (+21,4% YoY), 98 juta pelanggan, order volume 5-10x normal days (Kemendag via Katadata/Antara, Des 2024). Playbook: forecast + capacity stress test, temp labor onboarded 2-4 weeks ahead + cross-trained (pick/pack/returns), WMS tuned (batch sizing, wave rules, carrier API), overflow/mezzanine storage, carrier cutoff coordination, post-peak review. Source: racklify.com, golocad.com, Katadata.
verified_facts.sap_wms_gartner: SAP named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Warehouse Management Systems (recognized 2024 and 2026). Source: news.sap.com (per prior batch citations) — researcher to re-confirm the 2026 citation.
